CONTENT-ADDRESSED ALICE DERIVATION CANDIDATE — external /tmp only; no repository bytes and no parser/model run.

Source retrieved again from https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/11.txt.utf-8: 174,311 bytes, SHA-256 01b38ea4c710a84bc18d0bd41271a5a1a92b94e97b2812f4dece97d4a694725e. The object identifies Lewis Carroll, Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, Project Gutenberg eBook 11, Millennium Fulcrum Edition 3.0, credits Arthur DiBianca and David Widger, most recently updated 2025-06-26, and includes the Project Gutenberg redistribution terms plus its non-US jurisdiction warning.

Exact derivation recipe, proposed before any model configuration: (1) verify the raw byte hash, then decode UTF-8; (2) normalize CRLF and CR to LF; (3) select from the SECOND exact CHAPTER I. heading at normalized offset 1467 up to but excluding the next CHAPTER II. heading at 13023; (4) drop the CHAPTER I. and Down the Rabbit-Hole heading lines; (5) remove only the six ornament lines whose trimmed content fully matches (?:\*\s+){2,}\*; (6) trim each remaining wrapped line, join nonblank lines within each blank-delimited paragraph by one ASCII space, join paragraphs by two LF, and emit no terminal LF. No spelling, punctuation, quotation, emphasis, or wording changes.

Derived narrative: 11,252 UTF-16/Scala String chars, 11,478 UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 258816a8a2b7b597748343a9e8f8a5948e6bc828f289f27a4069c65e0f89cd5c. Independent Python SHA-256 matches storymodel4s StorySource.canonicalChecksum. The actual SurfaceAnalyzer yields 24 paragraphs, 71 sentences, and 2,552 tokens. Therefore the predeclared held-out denominator would be 71, not the 37-character Contents-table slice and not an unmeasured corpus.

Proposed header basis if bytes ever enter the repo: Source names Carroll plus this exact PG edition/transcribers; Basis records original 1865 UK publication and Project Gutenberg redistribution terms for the exact transcription, with the source’s non-US jurisdiction caveat; Modifications lists the six transformations above and their purpose (isolate narrative prose while preserving source characters); Tradition not applicable; Admitted by remains blank until independent sign-off. Please check the legal/edition wording and re-derive the checksum before any admission. This derivation remains outside the no-model contract slice.
